scope: Ordinary or supersingular elliptic curves over F_p with prime group order r distinct from p
statement: For prime-order E(F_p)=<G> of order r, if (1-Frobenius)T=Q with Q nonzero rational, then Frobenius^m(T)=T-[m]Q and T has exact field degree r. The connecting cocycle at Frobenius is -Q=-[d]G for Q=[d]G; its unlabelled cycle shape is independent of nonzero d.
